name: LtgClippingTab
src_typeComment: Clipping tab: spots objects intersecting each other when they shouldn't. Answers a PER-OBJECT CORRECTNESS question ("is this one thing placed wrong?"), which is why it's a separate tab from the Heatmap's whole-level distribution question rather than a mode inside it.  Built around one honest limitation: NOTHING can tell whether an intersection was intended, so this never claims to. It finds candidates cheaply, paints what's actually buried, and leaves the call to you.  Subjects vs Targets: only SUBJECTS get painted, so floors/architecture never light up — you see the crate reddened where it's buried, not the floor it's buried in.

src_members.name: Activate
src_members.comment: Drawn from Camera.onPostRender rather than a Scene-view GUI callback: the buried-portion pass needs the scene's real depth buffer still bound to ZTest against, and onPostRender fires immediately after a camera finishes rendering (target + depth intact).
